exposure.needed: whether cert-manager in the environment is installed or updated through OperatorHub (OLM subscription) rather than another distribution method

original.statement: cert-manager no longer publishes OperatorHub packages: v1.16.5 is the last release on OperatorHub (RedHat OpenShift OperatorHub and operatorhub.io), and the cert-manager-olm repository is archived.

decision.reason: [ev-a89ac42d3167] says cert-manager no longer publishes OperatorHub packages and that v1.16.5 is the last release on RedHat OpenShift OperatorHub and operatorhub.io. Only environments that install or update cert-manager through OperatorHub are exposed. The evidence names no Helm value, resource or other static marker that would show this distribution channel. An undecidable exposure that asks for exactly that information is therefore the right scope, neither broader nor narrower.
